DENIA-DENIA_AMARO.title: Amaro
DENIA-DENIA_AMARO.description: Whenever you switch forms, draw 1 card. Stacks.
DENIA-DENIA_ANGER.title: Wrath
DENIA-DENIA_ANGER.description:
Exhaust up to {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} cards from your current cards. Gain {IfUpgraded:show:8|6} Block per card exhausted.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: +2 Block per card.
DENIA-DENIA_BACK_TO_FAR.title: Return to Afar
DENIA-DENIA_BACK_TO_FAR.description:
All Fusion Burst applications apply additional stacks equal to {IfUpgraded:show:2 plus |}1/10 of the target's current Cap. Does not stack.
Dark Core Enhancement: Use 1/7 of Cap instead of 1/10.
DENIA-DENIA_FAKED_ILLNESS_TWO_DAYS.title: Two More Days of Pretending
DENIA-DENIA_BEHAVE.title: Behave~
DENIA-DENIA_BEHAVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain 2 Strength.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Deal another 15 damage.
DENIA-DENIA_BIRTHDAY_CAKE.title: Birthday Cake
DENIA-DENIA_BIRTHDAY_CAKE.description: At the start of each turn in Pink Form, gain 1 additional Dark Core. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_BORROW_ME.title: Let Me Borrow That
DENIA-DENIA_BORROW_ME.description:
Gain 3 Block for each type of debuff on each enemy and each type of buff on you.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Gain 1 more Block per type.
DENIA-DENIA_BUBBLE_MACHINE.title: Bubble Machine
DENIA-DENIA_BUBBLE_MACHINE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color]. If you switched forms this turn, gain {Block:diff()} [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color] again.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: both base Block values +2.
DENIA-DENIA_CANNED_FISH_CAKE.title: Canned Fish Muffin
DENIA-DENIA_CANNED_FISH_CAKE.description: For this turn, your Tune Strain Response stacks count as 2×.
DENIA-DENIA_CODE_WORD.title: Code Word
DENIA-DENIA_CONFORMAL_ENERGY.title: Conformal Energy
DENIA-DENIA_CONFORMAL_ENERGY.description:
Draw {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} cards.
Dark Core Enhancement: Gain 1 Energy.
DENIA-DENIA_CORROSION_DOMAIN.title: Corrosive Domain
DENIA-DENIA_CORROSION_DOMAIN.description: Draw {IfUpgraded:show:5|3} cards. Exhaust {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} cards from your Hand.
DENIA-DENIA_CRUSH.title: Crush
DENIA-DENIA_CRUSH.description: Costs 1 less for each [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst[/color] detonation you trigger this combat. This combat, concentrate the total damage your Fusion Burst would deal to ALL enemies on the detonated target. If there is only 1 enemy, count it as 2.{IfUpgraded:show: Gain 2 Shrouded Star.|}
DENIA-DENIA_CURTAIN_END.title: Final Curtain
DENIA-DENIA_CURTAIN_END.description: Choose a card in your hand. Put {IfUpgraded:show:an upgraded |}copy into your [color=#9A6A18]Draw Pile[/color].{IfUpgraded:show:| The copy gains [color=#9A6A18]Exhaust[/color] and [color=#9A6A18]Ethereal[/color].}
DENIA-DENIA_DEEP_ETERNAL.title: Deep Dark, End, Eternal
DENIA-DENIA_DEEP_ETERNAL.description:
Raise ALL enemies' Fusion Burst Cap by 3, then {IfUpgraded:show:trigger 1 unconditional detonation on each of 2 random enemies. If there is only 1 enemy, detonate it twice|trigger 1 unconditional detonation on a random enemy}. For the next 2 turns, at turn start apply Fusion Burst equal to {IfUpgraded:show:1/2|1/3} of Cap to ALL enemies, then raise their Cap by 3. If in Black Form, switch to Pink Form. The ongoing effect does not stack.
Dark Core Enhancement: gain 1 Energy.
DENIA-DENIA_DEFEND.title: Defend
DENIA-DENIA_DEFEND.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color]. If in [color=#9A6A18]Pink Form[/color], apply 1 [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst[/color] to a random enemy. Virtual Matter Enhancement: apply 2 [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst[/color] to a random enemy.
DENIA-DENIA_DETERMINATION.title: Feast
DENIA-DENIA_DETERMINATION.description:
Gain Block equal to twice the number of Tune Strain Response markers in your cards{IfUpgraded:show: plus 8|}.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Repeat the main effect.
DENIA-DENIA_DONT_COME_IN.title: Do Not... Come In
DENIA-DENIA_DONT_COME_IN.description: Switch forms. Gain 6 additional Virtual Matter.{IfUpgraded:show: Gain 1 additional Dark Core.|}
DENIA-DENIA_DREAM_WEAVE.title: Dreamweave
DENIA-DENIA_DREAM_WEAVE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Melt all enemies {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} times and increase their Fusion Burst Cap by {IfUpgraded:show:4|2}.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: After Melt resolves, apply 3 Fusion Burst to all enemies.
DENIA-DENIA_ENTROPY_BOOST.title: Entropy Boost
DENIA-DENIA_ENTROPY_BOOST.description:
Whenever you gain a buff or apply a debuff to an enemy, gain 2 Block, up to 6 times per turn. Does not stack.
Dark Core Enhancement: gain 1 additional Block each time.
DENIA-DENIA_ETCHED_IRIDESCENT.title: Etched Iridescence
DENIA-DENIA_ETCHED_IRIDESCENT.descriptio:
Create a {IfUpgraded:show:{StakeHpUpgraded}|{StakeHp}} HP stake on the enemy side. The stake takes double damage from [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst[/color] detonations and [color=#9A6A18]Resonance Break[/color]. When the stake is killed by players, all players immediately heal {IfUpgraded:show:15|10} HP.
Dark Core Enhancement: double the heal.
DENIA-DENIA_EXILE.title: Exile
DENIA-DENIA_EXILE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} cards.
Dark Core Enhancement: Draw 2 additional cards.
DENIA-DENIA_ENDED.title: Settle This
DENIA-DENIA_ENDED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: repeat the effect.
DENIA-DENIA_INSPECTION_REPORT_RA2499_G.d: This combat, concentrate the total damage your [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst[/color] would deal to ALL enemies on the detonated target.
DENIA-DENIA_FERN_ALGAE_CAKE.title: Fern-Algae Cake
DENIA-DENIA_FERN_ALGAE_CAKE.description:
Deal 7 × {IfUpgraded:show:(X + 1)|X} damage to all enemies.
Dark Core Enhancement: Add 9Y damage to the same hit.
DENIA-DENIA_FINISH_QUICKLY.title: End This Quickly
DENIA-DENIA_IM_BACK.title: I'm Back!
DENIA-DENIA_IM_BACK.description: In either form, gain 20 Virtual Matter and 5 Dark Core. If in Pink Form, switch to Black Form.
DENIA-DENIA_FIRST_AND_LAST_GIFT.title: The First and Final Gift
DENIA-DENIA_FIRST_AND_LAST_GIFT.descript: For the rest of this combat, whenever you play a card, apply Tune Strain Response to that card.
DENIA-DENIA_FOAM_BAIT.title: Foam Honey Bait
DENIA-DENIA_FOAM_BAIT.description:
Deal {IfUpgraded:show:15|10} damage to ALL enemies.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: damage +5.
DENIA-DENIA_FROM_FAR.title: From Afar
DENIA-DENIA_FROM_FAR.description:
Whenever you increase an enemy’s Fusion Burst Cap, increase it by {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} more. If it is already 40, Melt the enemy {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} instead. Does not stack.
Dark Core Enhancement: Both amounts increase by 1.
DENIA-DENIA_FROZEN_STAR_MOSS_CAKE.title: Frozen Star-Moss Cake
DENIA-DENIA_FROZEN_STAR_MOSS_CAKE.descri:
Apply X Tune Strain Bias, then trigger unconditional Resonance Break X times{IfUpgraded:show:.| and lose X Energy.}
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Deal an additional 3 × (Y - 2) / 2 damage.
DENIA-DENIA_FRUIT_OF_LIES.title: Fruit of Lies
DENIA-DENIA_FRUIT_OF_LIES.description: Gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} Dark Core. If you switched forms this turn, gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} additional Dark Core.
DENIA-DENIA_GET_SUN.title: Obtain the Sun
DENIA-DENIA_GET_SUN.description:
For every 2 Fusion Burst you apply, apply Tune Strain Response to a random card in your deck. Does not stack.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Regain 1 Energy.
DENIA-DENIA_GIVE_IT_BACK.title: Give It Back
DENIA-DENIA_GIVE_IT_BACK.description: If there are multiple enemies, copy the target’s debuffs to the other enemies, including Fusion Burst, bonus Fusion Burst Cap, and Tune Strain debuffs. If there is only one enemy, apply 1 Tune Strain Bias, 8 Fusion Burst, and 5 Fusion Burst Cap.
DENIA-DENIA_GRADUATION_MESSAGE.title: Graduation Message
DENIA-DENIA_GRADUATION_MESSAGE.descripti:
Gain 1 Energy.
Dark Core Enhancement: gain 1 Energy.
DENIA-DENIA_HAPPY_BIRTHDAY.title: Happy Birthday
DENIA-DENIA_ROY_FAIRY_TALE.title: Roi Fairy Tales
DENIA-DENIA_ROY_FAIRY_TALE.description:
Choose {IfUpgraded:show:7|4} cards from your deck to gain [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Response[/color].
Virtual Matter Enhancement: choose 2 additional cards.
DENIA-DENIA_HEART_LOCK.title: Heart Lock
DENIA-DENIA_HEART_LOCK.description: In Black Form, gain 12 Virtual Matter. In Pink Form, gain 2 Energy.{IfUpgraded:show: Draw 1 card.|}
DENIA-DENIA_HUMAN_PREFERENCE.title: Human Preference
DENIA-DENIA_HUMAN_PREFERENCE.description: Apply 2 Tune Strain Bias to {IfUpgraded:show:all enemies|the target} and trigger unconditional Resonance Break.
DENIA-DENIA_ITS_MY_TURN.title: It Is My Turn
DENIA-DENIA_ITS_MY_TURN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {IfUpgraded:show:13|10} Fusion Burst{IfUpgraded:show: and 6 Fusion Burst Cap|}. Draw {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} cards. If you are in Black Form, switch to Pink Form.
DENIA-DENIA_KA_NIU.title: Kaniu
DENIA-DENIA_KA_NIU.description:
Whenever you switch forms, gain 1 Energy. Does not stack.{IfUpgraded:show:
When played, gain 2 Strength and 2 Shrouded Star.|}
DENIA-DENIA_KARAKARA.title: Karakara
DENIA-DENIA_KARAKARA.description:
Gain Strength equal to the target's Vulnerable stacks and Shrouded Star equal to 1/5 of their Fusion Burst Cap, rounded up.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Also gain Strength equal to 1/5 of Cap and Shrouded Star equal to their Vulnerable stacks.
DENIA-DENIA_KEEP_RUNNING.title: Keep Running?
DENIA-DENIA_KEEP_RUNNING.description: This turn, whenever you play a card, apply Burst equal to {IfUpgraded:show:1/3|1/4} of the target's Cap (rounded up).
DENIA-DENIA_KNOCK_DOOR.title: A Gentle Knock
DENIA-DENIA_KNOCK_DOOR.description: Choose: All enemies lose {IfUpgraded:show:6|4} Strength, or the target loses {IfUpgraded:show:8|6} Strength. Lasts 1 turn.
DENIA-DENIA_LIGHT_CALL.title: Gentle Call
DENIA-DENIA_LIGHT_CALL.description: Whenever you apply Fusion Burst, also apply half as many Vulnerable stacks, rounded up. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_LONG_TIME_NO_SEE.title: Long Time No See
DENIA-DENIA_LONG_TIME_NO_SEE.description:
Choose: Apply {IfUpgraded:show:5|3} Weak to the target, or {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} Weak to all enemies.
Dark Core Enhancement: Gain Strength equal to the total Weak applied if you played Look at Me during this Black Form, or that much Shrouded Star if you played Pity Me. Gain both if you entered through Please Do Not... Forgive Me. Lose these bonuses when returning to Pink Form.
DENIA-DENIA_LOOK_AT_ME.title: Look at Me
DENIA-DENIA_LOOK_AT_ME.description:
Only works in [color=#9A6A18]Black Form[/color].
Exhaust "Look at Me" and "Pity Me" in your hand.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: enter [color=#9A6A18]Resonance Mode: Tune Strain[/color]. Leaving [color=#9A6A18]Black Form[/color] also leaves [color=#9A6A18]Resonance Mode: Tune Strain[/color].
DENIA-DENIA_LOOK_AT_THIS.title: What Did You See?
DENIA-DENIA_LOOK_AT_THIS.description:
Apply 1 [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Bias[/color] to ALL enemies. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Choose {IfUpgraded:show:4|2} cards from your deck to gain [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Response[/color].
Virtual Matter Enhancement: apply 1 more [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Bias[/color].
DENIA-DENIA_POMMEL_STRIKE.title: Pommel Strike
DENIA-DENIA_POMMEL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. {IfUpgraded:show:Apply 1 Tune Strain Bias and trigger unconditional Resonance Break.|If the target had Tune Strain Bias before this card was played, apply 1 more.}
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Finally, deal another 10 damage.
DENIA-DENIA_MELTING_AWAY.title: Melted Away
DENIA-DENIA_MELTING_AWAY.description:
Trigger 1 unconditional Fusion Burst Cap detonation on a random enemy. If in Black Form, switch to Pink Form. At the start of each subsequent turn, raise ALL enemies' Fusion Burst Cap by 1 (up to the hard cap), then apply Fusion Burst equal to {IfUpgraded:show:1/3|1/4} of Cap. The ongoing effect does not stack.
Dark Core Enhancement: those Cap and Burst amounts +2.
DENIA-DENIA_MIMIC_BUBBLE.title: Mimic Bubble
DENIA-DENIA_MIMIC_BUBBLE.description:
Gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} Slippery.
Dark Core Enhancement: Shuffle a copy of this card into your Draw Pile.
DENIA-DENIA_MOONLIGHT_SWORD.title: Adula's Moonblade
DENIA-DENIA_MOONLIGHT_SWORD.description: Enemies without Frostbite lose 20% of their maximum HP. Apply Frostbite to all enemies.
DENIA-DENIA_OBEY.title: Obey
DENIA-DENIA_OBEY.description: Draw 2 cards. Choose up to {IfUpgraded:show:4|3} cards in your hand to Exhaust. Gain 1 [color=#9A6A18]Artifact[/color] for each card Exhausted.
DENIA-DENIA_ORANGE_CAKE.title: Orange Cake
DENIA-DENIA_ORANGE_CAKE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Draw {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} cards.
Dark Core Enhancement: Draw 2 additional cards.
DENIA-DENIA_PHANTOM_FORM.title: Phantom Form
DENIA-DENIA_PHANTOM_FORM.description:
Apply {IfUpgraded:show:10|6} Fusion Burst and gain {Block:diff()} Block. If this card triggers a detonation, gain another {Block:diff()} Block.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Apply 3 more Fusion Burst.
DENIA-DENIA_PINE_NEEDLE_ROCK_FLOSS.title: Pine-Needle Rock-Floss Roll
DENIA-DENIA_PINE_NEEDLE_ROCK_FLOSS.descr:
Apply {IfUpgraded:show:6|4} [color=#9A6A18]Vulnerable[/color] to the target.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: gain 2 [color=#9A6A18]Strength[/color].
DENIA-DENIA_PITY_ME.title: Pity Me
DENIA-DENIA_PITY_ME.description:
Only works in [color=#9A6A18]Black Form[/color].
Exhaust "Look at Me" and "Pity Me" in your hand.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: gain 2 [color=#9A6A18]Shrouded Star[/color] (lost when leaving [color=#9A6A18]Black Form[/color]).
DENIA-DENIA_LAST_LIE.title: The Final Lie
DENIA-DENIA_LAST_LIE.description:
Apply 1 [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Bias[/color], deal {Damage:diff()} damage, choose {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} cards in your deck to gain [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Response[/color].
Virtual Matter Enhancement: damage +8.
DENIA-DENIA_PLEASE_DO_NOT.title: Please Do Not...
DENIA-DENIA_PLEASE_DO_NOT_FORGIVE_ME.des: In Pink Form, switch to Black Form without gaining Look at Me or Pity Me. Gain 4 Shrouded Star and 2 Strength, and enter Resonance Mode: Tune Strain. When leaving Black Form, lose the Shrouded Star gained this way and leave this Resonance Mode.
DENIA-DENIA_RADIANCE_DISSOLVED.title: Radiance, Dissolved Hereafter
DENIA-DENIA_RADIANCE_DISSOLVED.descripti:
Spend all [color=#9A6A18]Virtual Matter[/color] and Dark Core. Deal y/2+4z+Strength damage to ALL enemies x times. Switch to [color=#9A6A18]Pink Form[/color].
If you do not win within {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} turns, gain 80 Doom.
DENIA-DENIA_RAINBOW_CANDY_JUMP.title: Rainbow Bean Popping Candy
DENIA-DENIA_RAINBOW_CANDY_JUMP.descripti: Whenever you gain Virtual Matter in Pink Form, gain 2 more. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_RESONANCE_MODE.title: Resonance Mode: Tune Strain
DENIA-DENIA_RESONANCE_MODE.description: For this combat, your Tune Strain Response stacks count as 1.5×, stacking with similar effects. Apply Tune Strain Response to any 2 cards in your deck.
DENIA-DENIA_RUPTURE.title: Rupture
DENIA-DENIA_RUPTURE.description:
Deal {IfUpgraded:show:10|8} damage to ALL enemies twice.
Then deal damage equal to the sum of all Caps {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} times.
Dark Core Enhancement: each hit +5.
DENIA-DENIA_SALINE.title: Saline
DENIA-DENIA_SALINE.description: Switch forms. Gain 1 [color=#9A6A18]Vulnerable[/color]. Gain {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} [color=#9A6A18]Strength[/color]{IfUpgraded:show:, 1 [color=#9A6A18]Dexterity[/color]|}, and {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} [color=#9A6A18]Shrouded Star[/color].
DENIA-DENIA_SEAMLESS.title: Seamless
DENIA-DENIA_SEAMLESS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: +3 base damage and Block.
DENIA-DENIA_SEND_YOU_IN.title: Send You In
DENIA-DENIA_SEND_YOU_IN.description: Steal all of the target's Buffs.
DENIA-DENIA_SMELT.title: Smelt
DENIA-DENIA_SMELT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Melt 2.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: +2 Block.
DENIA-DENIA_SO_TIRED.title: So Tired, Let Me Rest...
DENIA-DENIA_SO_TIRED.description:
Gain 9 [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color]. If you applied a buff or debuff this turn, gain 9 additional [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color].
Dark Core Enhancement: both Block values +4.
DENIA-DENIA_SORROW.title: Sorrow
DENIA-DENIA_SORROW.description:
Apply 1 Tune Strain Bias, {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} Fusion Burst Cap and {IfUpgraded:show:5|3} Fusion Burst.
Dark Core Enhancement: Trigger unconditional Resonance Break.
DENIA-DENIA_STAGE_SETUP.title: Stage-Set Form
DENIA-DENIA_STAGE_SETUP.description:
Deal {IfUpgraded:show:13|10} damage to all enemies. Increase their Fusion Burst Cap by {IfUpgraded:show:5|3}, then apply {IfUpgraded:show:9|6} Fusion Burst.
Dark Core Enhancement: Costs 1 less Energy.
DENIA-DENIA_STRIKE.title: Strike
DENIA-DENIA_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
In Pink Form, add 1 Fusion Burst Cap.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: +2 base damage.
DENIA-DENIA_PROOF_OF_PERSONALITY.title: Proof of Personhood
DENIA-DENIA_PROOF_OF_PERSONALITY.descrip: Whenever you apply Tune Strain Bias, if the target has less than 2 Bias afterward, apply 1 additional Bias; otherwise, trigger an unconditional Resonance Break. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_SUNSHINE_SEASON.title: Season of Sunshine
DENIA-DENIA_SUNSHINE_SEASON.description: Switch forms. Draw {IfUpgraded:show:4|2} cards and gain 2 Dark Core.
DENIA-DENIA_SWALLOW.title: Swallow
DENIA-DENIA_SWALLOW.description: {IfUpgraded:show:For each Tune Strain Response marker in your cards and each stack of Tune Strain Response power, enemies deal 4% less damage to you, up to 60%. Recalculate at the end of each player turn.|For each stack of Tune Strain Response power, enemies with Tune Strain Interference deal 3% less damage to you, up to 45%.} Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_TEAR.title: Tear
DENIA-DENIA_TEAR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: damage +8.
DENIA-DENIA_TIMED_RUIN.title: Timed Ruin
DENIA-DENIA_TIMED_RUIN.description: Increase each enemy’s Fusion Burst Cap by {IfUpgraded:show:4|2}, then apply Fusion Burst equal to {IfUpgraded:show:2/3|2/5} of their Cap.
DENIA-DENIA_TORCH_PINE_NUT.title: Torch Pine Nut
DENIA-DENIA_TORCH_PINE_NUT.description: Whenever you gain Shrouded Star, gain {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} times as much Strength. Does not stack. This Strength remains when you lose that Shrouded Star.
DENIA-DENIA_UNFINISHED_LIE.title: Unfinished Lie
DENIA-DENIA_UNFINISHED_LIE.description:
Increase the target’s Fusion Burst Cap by {IfUpgraded:show:5|3}, then apply {IfUpgraded:show:12|8} Fusion Burst. If this card triggers a detonation, gain 1 Energy.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Increase both amounts by 2.
DENIA-DENIA_UNTIL_NEXT_TIME.title: Until We Meet Again
DENIA-DENIA_UNTIL_NEXT_TIME.description: Switch forms, draw 2. Black to Pink keeps Virtual Matter; Pink to Black gains +10 Virtual Matter. Gain 1 Dark Core.
DENIA-DENIA_VIRTUAL_PARTICLE.title: Virtual Particle
DENIA-DENIA_VIRTUAL_PARTICLE.description:
Apply Tune Strain Response to all your current cards.
Dark Core Enhancement: Add a copy of this card to your Discard Pile.
DENIA-DENIA_VIRTUAL_SCIENCE_INTUITION.de: For this combat, gain 1 Energy for every 6 Virtual Matter spent. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_VISIT.title: A Formal Visit
DENIA-DENIA_VISIT.description: For this combat, you take at most {IfUpgraded:show:15|20} damage per turn, but deal at most {IfUpgraded:show:80|60} damage to each enemy per turn. Lasts {IfUpgraded:show:5|4} turns.
DENIA-DENIA_WORTHLESS_INDIVIDUAL.title: "Worthless Individual"
DENIA-DENIA_WORTHLESS_INDIVIDUAL.descrip:
Apply Tune Strain Response to {IfUpgraded:show:3|1} cards in your Hand. Trigger unconditional Resonance Break.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Apply 2 Vulnerable.
DENIA-DENIA_WISH_SILENCE.title: May You Dwell in Silence
DENIA-DENIA_WISH_SILENCE.description:
[color=#9A6A18]Melt[/color] {IfUpgraded:show:3|2}.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: [color=#9A6A18]Melt[/color] 2. Melts from this card do not consume Burst stacks.
DENIA-DENIA_XIA_YE.title: Xia Ye
DENIA-DENIA_XIA_YE.description: Dark Core Enhancement: Whenever you switch forms, gain 1 Dark Core. Stacks.
DENIA-DENIA_YAYA.title: ?! Yaya ?!
DENIA-DENIA_YAYA.description:
Trigger unconditional Resonance Break. If in Black Form, switch to Pink Form.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Then deal 4 damage twice.
DENIA-DENIA_FIRST_LIE.title: The First Lie
DENIA-DENIA_YOU_TRY_IT.title: You Try It Too?
DENIA-DENIA_YOU_TRY_IT.description: For the rest of this turn, each card you play adds {IfUpgraded:show:4|2} Fusion Burst Cap to the target. If Cap is already 40, Melt 1 instead{IfUpgraded:show: without consuming Fusion Burst|}.
DENIA-DENIA_TRIBE_EVOLUTION_ERROR.title: Tribal Evolution Error
DENIA-DENIA_TRIBE_EVOLUTION_ERROR.descri:
{IfUpgraded:show:Apply 2 Tune Strain Bias and |}Trigger unconditional Resonance Break. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Virtual Matter Enhancement: +10 damage.
DENIA-DENIA_IMMERSE_INTO_VOID.title: Immerse Into Void
DENIA-DENIA_IMMERSE_INTO_VOID.descriptio: Gain {IfUpgraded:show:5|2} Shrouded Star. For the rest of this combat, your Melts do not consume Fusion Burst.
DENIA-DENIA_TAINTED_DARKNESS.title: Tainted Darkness
DENIA-DENIA_TAINTED_DARKNESS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 7 times. At the end of each of your next 3 turns, deal {DelayedDamage:diff()} damage to the target. If you take unblocked damage during that time, cancel the remaining attacks.
Dark Core Enhancement: each hit's base damage +2.
DENIA-DENIA_EXTINGUISHED_DREAM.title: Extinguished Dream
DENIA-DENIA_EXTINGUISHED_DREAM.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#9A6A18]Block[/color]. Apply 1 [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Bias[/color].
Virtual Matter Enhancement: Block +5.
DENIA-DENIA_PHANTOM_FOAM.title: Phantom Foam
DENIA-DENIA_PHANTOM_FOAM.description: Whenever Virtual Matter Enhancement triggers, gain 3 Block, up to {IfUpgraded:show:6|4} times per turn. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_TOWARD_VOID.title: Toward the Void
DENIA-DENIA_TOWARD_VOID.description: Whenever Dark Core Enhancement triggers, gain {IfUpgraded:show:7|6} Block, up to 3 times per turn. Does not stack.
DENIA-DENIA_VIRTUAL_MATTER_MAGNETIC_BURS: For this turn, your Virtual Matter is fixed at 20{IfUpgraded:show:, and your Dark Core is fixed at 5|}. At end of turn, clear all Virtual Matter and Dark Core.
DENIA-DENIA_PEACH_ICE.title: Peach Ice
DENIA-DENIA_PEACH_ICE.description: Apply {IfUpgraded:show:40|20} [color=#9A6A18]Fusion Burst Cap[/color] to the target.
DENIA-DENIA_MINT_CANDY.title: Mint Candy
DENIA-DENIA_MINT_CANDY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, then gain 20 [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain Response[/color] and apply 2 [color=#9A6A18]Tune Strain · Interference[/color] to the target.
DENIA-DENIA_WEAK_SINGLE_CHOICE.title: Single Target: Weak
DENIA-DENIA_WEAK_ALL_CHOICE.title: All Enemies: Weak
